table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	H.PurinvCode,
	H.Date, 
	purtype=(select Name from purchasetype where purchasetype.purtypecode=max(H.purtypecode)),
	H.SuppinvCode, 
	H.SuppInvDate,
	creditdays=max(H.creditdays),
	AliasName = A.aliasname,
	Supplier = A.name,
	SupplierCategory = (SELECT SC.Name FROM SupplierCategory SC WHERE SC.SuppCatCode=S.SuppCatCode),
	NTNNo = S.NTNNo, 
	SalesTaxRegNo = S.SalesTaxRegNo, 
	WHPerc = S.WHPerc,
	H.Posted,
	SaleTax=ROUND( 
			SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty + D.bonusqty) *
				D.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM(((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice) * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * H.discperc)) - H.flatdisc) * 
				(H.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), ISNULL((SELECT A=dbo.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('roundpurinvon')), 0)),
	Gross=  ROUND(SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
			(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * H.discperc)) + 
			H.misccharges + H.salestax - H.flatdisc, ISNULL((SELECT A=dbo.Fn_Get_Int_Preference('roundpurinvon')), 0)),
	H.Remarks,
	Balance = ISNULL((SELECT Balance=DBO.Fn_AccountBalance(H.PostDate, H.SuppCode) ),0),
	AdvanceTaxAmt = H.AdvanceTaxAmt,
	OutstandingAmt=H.OutstandingAmt
FROM 
	Purledger H, Purdetail D, Accounts A, Supplier S
WHERE 
	H.PurInvCode = :ai_invcode AND
	H.Purinvcode = D.Purinvcode AND
	H.SuppCode = A.AccCode AND
	H.SuppCode = S.SuppCode AND
	S.SuppCode = A.AccCode
GROUP BY
	H.PurinvCode,
	H.Date,
	H.SuppinvCode,
	H.SuppInvDate,
	H.Posted,
	H.DiscPerc,
	H.FlatDisc,
	H.InvGSTPerc1,
	H.SalesTax,
	H.MiscCharges,
	H.Remarks,
	H.Suppcode,
	H.PostDate,
	H.OutstandingAmt,
	H.AdvanceTaxAmt,
	S.SuppCatCode,
	S.NTNNo, 
	S.SalesTaxRegNo, 
	S.WHPerc,
	A.AliasName,
	A.name
